name: RenderBackend in the renderer; GpuRenderer implements it and is split by job
body: RenderBackend and RenderReport move from lantern:::host to lantern:::renderer, beside RenderWorld; HeadlessRenderer gets its own file there. GpuRenderer implements RenderBackend itself, so the GpuRenderBackend adapter and the duplicate FrameReport go. GpuRenderer.nox is split: GpuDevice (device, swapchain, formats), GpuUniforms (the shader constant blocks), GpuDrawList (sorting), and the frame into DrawMeshes, DrawLines and DrawOverlay. Frustum moves to the renderer, since culling isn't SDL's.
